issue_context.title: Remove recently loaded scenes
issue_context.body:
The idea of having a history of scenes that were previously worked on is good. This is useful. However, the current design is not. Having a dropdown with a list of random ids is not very intuitive, there's no way to edit it...

We should remove the current implementation and when/if we have a better design, then do it again.

If someone wants to remove some code, this issue is the right one for you :)
comments: In the orig PR I suggested to use scene name (when non-random) + relative date (e.g. `myScene (2 days ago)`). Moving it to the scene menu might also improve the UI issue.

What about doing something similar to how most design apps create the "Page" system. For example, this is from Figma.
